instruction: Find information about privacy policy on the Ticketek website.

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to navigate from Ticketek homepage to the privacy policy page. Evaluator checks if the active tab URL contains 'privacy' pattern.
metadata.verification_notes: Using existing is_expected_url_pattern_match metric. Pattern 'privacy' will match URLs like '/privacy-policy', '/privacy', etc.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirements
Result getter 'active_tab_info' properly extracts active tab URL from accessibility tree and returns dict with 'url', 'title', 'content' fields
Metric 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' correctly handles both string URLs and dict with 'url' field, properly extracting URL for pattern matching
Pattern matching uses re.search() to check if 'privacy' appears anywhere in URL, which will match URLs like '/privacy', '/privacy-policy', '/privacy-statement', etc.
Expected value semantically correct: pattern 'privacy' appropriately verifies navigation to privacy policy page
Complete coverage: instruction asks to 'find information about privacy policy' and evaluator verifies user navigated to a privacy-related page by checking URL pattern
No postconfig needed: verification only requires checking active tab URL, no UI state dependencies
Metric function correctly handles parameter: when expected.type='rule', metric receives rules dict directly and correctly accesses rules['expected'] to get pattern list
